name: gizza-ai/video-fps
summary: Change a video's frame rate with frame drop/duplication

tool.description: Change a video's frame rate to a fixed target (e.g. 60→30, or any chosen fps). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call), plus fps (target frames per second, default 30). Lowering the rate drops frames; raising it duplicates them — the clip's duration is unchanged, only its frames-per-second. The video is re-encoded to H.264 (crf 20); audio is kept as-is. mp4/mov/m4v/mkv inputs keep their container; other inputs (e.g. webm) are converted to MP4. fps is clamped to 1-240.

fps.description: Target frame rate in frames per second (e.g. 30, 24, 60). Lowering drops frames, raising duplicates them; the clip's duration is unchanged. Default 30. Clamped to 1-240.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
